Amekana' s Story

     Amekana is a highly trusted, Stylish, Sexy, and Chic online boutique, which is a standout in the online fashion retail community. Amekana is located in Texas. Our goal is to help you look like a million bucks without spending a million dollars. We meet that goal every single day by providing amazingly sexy, stunningly beautiful celebrity inspired fashion styles for women of all shapes and sizes. The apparel we offer is high-quality, stylish, fashionable, and affordable.

 

Trend #1: Hint of skin

 

One of the biggest trends in the last few years has been a hint of skin here and there. While these dresses are incredibly flattering to your body, you won’t feel the need to constantly cover up. You’ll feel confident, bold, and beautiful in the parts of your body that you choose to show off. For example, in this Diamond Gal Diamante Evening Dress has subtle cutouts that show just the right amount of skin. You can be comfortable and classy while still feeling like you’re doing your body justice.

 

Trend #2: Illusion gowns

 

Want to be a trophy wife? Strut your stuff in an illusion gown that’s all the rage this season. Illusion gowns are sleek and sophisticated. They add dazzle with their beads and glitter and allow you to give off classy vibes no matter what event you’re going to. The Trophy Wife Diamante Evening Dress or the Beautiful Entrance Dress are two perfect dresses that fit the bill for an illusion gown.

 

Trend #3: Glitter, glitter, glitter

Who doesn’t love a little sparkle and shine? Like we said, if you want to “wow,” then this might just be the trend for you. Glitter gowns are back and in full force. The best part about these gowns is that they come in all shapes and sizes. Do you love ball gowns? There’s a glitter gown for you. What about mermaid? That style loves glitter too. In fact, we’re not sure there’s any gown that doesn’t come in glitter form. Check out some of these beauties. They will have you dazzling all night and feeling beautiful while you do it.

Brianna Rose Diamante Evening Dress – Love florals and sparkle all at once? This dress is the one for you. Its unique flair will have everyone else on the floor when they see the roses decorating you in every which way.

Sheila Diamante Red Dress – Have a thing for mermaid style? The Sheila will showcase your body in a wonderfully feminine way while giving you the glittery appearance that you love. It’s subtly bedazzled in rhinestones while it’s the collarbone has a build in statement necklace.
